howItWorks.title: How Mooring Booking Works

howItWorks.step1Desc: Find your perfect mooring by location, date, and boat size across 10+ Mediterranean countries. Free for all registered users.

privacy.overviewText: At Mooring Booking, operated by Intelligent Matrix, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our platform.

gdpr.subtitle: Your rights under the General Data Protection Regulation
gdpr.commitmentText: Mooring Booking, operated by Intelligent Matrix, is committed to protecting your personal data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
gdpr.rightAccessDesc: You can request a copy of all personal data we hold about you.
gdpr.rightRectificationDesc: You can request correction of inaccurate personal data.
gdpr.rightErasureDesc: You can request deletion of your personal data ("right to be forgotten").
gdpr.rightPortabilityDesc: You can receive your data in a machine-readable format.
gdpr.rightObjectDesc: You can object to processing of your personal data.
gdpr.rightRestrictDesc: You can request restriction of processing in certain circumstances.
gdpr.supervisoryText: If you believe your data protection rights have been violated, you have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. In Austria, this is the Austrian Data Protection Authority (Datenschutzbehörde — DSB). For users in Croatia, the relevant authority is AZOP (Personal Data Protection Agency).
